task.title: M2: Run analysis off the serve event loop
task.description:
codeviz serve runs analyzeRef inline, and the walker plus git history work is mostly synchronous, so every request (including GET /api/snapshots and static assets) stalls for about a second while an analysis runs, the UI freezes on an analyze click, and the 409 in-progress response almost never fires. Move analysis into a worker_threads worker or a child process (spawning the CLI itself with --json is the simplest) so the server stays responsive, the in-flight set actually guards concurrent requests, and progress can be reported.

Acceptance criteria:
- During POST /api/analyze for a ref that takes about 1s, a concurrent GET /api/snapshots responds within 50ms.
- A second POST /api/analyze for the same ref while one is running returns 409.
- Analysis failures surface as 400/500 JSON from the server, not as crashes of the serve process.
- SIGINT during an in-flight analysis still leaves no temporary git worktree behind.
- Only node:* APIs are used; the existing server.test.ts passes and gains one concurrency assertion.
